messages:
elaine: Heads-up — onboarding reported a fail: REST route create returns 201 but Rust SDK client returns 422 (validation error). Payload looks the same on the app side. Anyone seen parity issues for route creation?

mike: Can you paste the REST vs SDK payloads? my gut says a naming/serialization mismatch or the SDK is dropping a top-level field.

elaine: Repro below. REST OK:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"name":"onboard-rust","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v3","timeout":40}'
```
Rust SDK (422):
```rust
// using redwood_sdk_rust = "0.2.0" in sample-app
let payload = RouteCreate {
    name: "onboard-rust".into(),
    model: "gpt-open-3".into(),
    timeout_ms: Some(40000),
    // no model_variant field in the struct
};
client.routes().create(&payload).await?;
```

mike: ah — Rust struct only has `timeout_ms` and lacks `model_variant`. Also serde config will skip unknowns by default, so if the server expects `model_variant` it's never sent. Backend validates `model_variant` for that model and returns 422.

ryan: there's a second problem: the onboard wrapper uses a retry middleware on the HTTP client that will retry POSTs on certain 5xx. For this customer we saw duplicate creations because upstream actually processed the first request but returned a 502 and the client retried.

elaine: server logs show two POSTs ~1s apart with different request ids and no Idempotency-Key header: 
```
[2028-08-01T12:00:01Z] POST /v1/routes req_id=r_111 upstream=502
[2028-08-01T12:00:02Z] POST /v1/routes req_id=r_112 created
```
Customer observed duplicate route entries.

mike: Short-term mitigation: callers should set an `Idempotency-Key` header and disable auto-retry for non-idempotent endpoints. Example workaround in Rust using reqwest: 
```rust
let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
let mut hdrs = HeaderMap::new();
hdrs.insert("Idempotency-Key", id.parse().unwrap());
client.set_default_headers(hdrs);
client.set_retry_policy(RetryPolicy::none());
client.routes().create(&payload).await?;
```

ryan: I'll coordinate an ops alert that flags multiple route creations with identical payloads within a 3s window while SDK fixes are rolling out.

elaine: I'll open a ticket and attach the failing sample app + exact SDK version and logs. Proposed dev fixes: 1) expose `model_variant` on RouteCreate struct (optional String), 2) accept both `timeout` (seconds) and `timeout_ms` and normalize during serialization, 3) avoid dropping unknown top-level keys silently (or at least warn), 4) change retry defaults so auto-retry is enabled only for idempotent methods; require explicit Idempotency-Key opt-in for POST retries.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-7001: "rust-sdk: route create parity — add model_variant, normalize timeout, and tighten POST retry defaults" — https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-7001 :robot_face:

mike: I'll take the Rust SDK changes. Plan: add `model_variant: Option<String>` on the RouteCreate type, implement `From<Timeout>` helper that accepts seconds or ms, and change middleware so POSTs are not retried unless an Idempotency-Key header is present. I'll add a unit test that serializes the RouteCreate to JSON and diffs it against a canonical REST example.

ryan: Ops follow-up: I'll create the temporary alert and add a short runbook for CS to remediate duplicates (delete the duplicate route and search for correlated request ids).

elaine: Thanks — attaching repro to DEVEX-7001 and will update when I have a confirmed test. Leaving thread. :thumbsup:
